ideal: Each change is a small pull request, stacked when large, linked to its issue, reviewed at its green head, and merged within the hour.

parts.ideal: A short queue: each open pull request is under a day old, green and free of conflicts
parts.setup: Open one small pull request per change; the Claude app's monitor with Auto-fix repairs red checks and conflicts

parts.ideal: A table of facts, a diagram where a flow changed, a linked issue or card, and few prose words
parts.setup: Fill the pull request template; write Closes or Part of before the issue number

parts.ideal: An author's list empties the same day; no change is over 400 reviewed lines
parts.setup: One change and its test per pull request; split a large one, or stack it, before review

parts.ideal: No request waits past an hour of green; the review reads the head commit that merges
parts.setup: Request a person or team; where one account authors and merges, post a verdict comment naming the head commit

parts.ideal: Nothing sits assigned or mentioned without an answer; every review thread is resolved before the merge
parts.setup: Assign whoever merges; answer or resolve each comment; a blocked pull request names what it waits on

parts.ideal: Labels come from automation, such as dependencies and area; a milestone only where a release is planned
parts.setup: Let Dependabot label its pull requests; leave Milestones empty unless a release needs one

parts.ideal: A large change is a stack of small pull requests based on the default branch, merged bottom up, never into a side branch
parts.setup: Create it with gh stack or the stacks API; the base branch's rules and checks then apply to every layer

parts.ideal: Squashed at the reviewed head within the hour of green, with every check passed and the branch deleted, never reverted
parts.setup: Allow squash only, delete head branches, and require the CI check in a ruleset; merge pinned to the reviewed commit
